resolution_claim_assessment.claimed_theorem: No strongly regular graph with parameters (99,14,1,2) exists.
resolution_claim_assessment.paper_justification: Every vertex of Hk2 is asserted to be adjacent to exactly two vertices of Hk1.
resolution_claim_assessment.gap: For y in Hk2, y and wk are nonadjacent, so mu=2 gives two common neighbors in the entire graph. Since each has two neighbors in the first layer L1=N(w0), a shared L1 neighbor can consume one of those two common neighbors. The paper supplies no argument excluding this case, so exactly two Hk1 neighbors and equation (88) do not follow.
resolution_claim_assessment.status_effect: The displayed proof does not substantiate the resolution claim as written. Later specialized sources continue to treat the target as open. Target truth remains UNKNOWN.
